API stability — janusplot

Source: API_STABILITY.md

Policy. This package follows Semantic Versioning and the lifecycle vocabulary for individual symbols.

Stability stages

  • experimental — may change in any release; every change is recorded in NEWS.md.
  • stable — public API; breaking changes only at major-version bumps, with at least one minor version of overlap via lifecycle::deprecate_warn().
  • superseded — a better alternative exists; the symbol is kept working but is not extended.
  • deprecated — scheduled for removal; emits a lifecycle deprecation and is removed after at least one minor version.

What the stable promise covers

For the symbols marked stable, the promise covers their names, their argument names and what each argument means, and the documented columns of summary(), including the 27 shape label names. Three things sit outside it and may change in a minor release, with a NEWS.md entry:

  • Default appearance: colours, palettes, layout thresholds and the compact tiers. Results do not depend on them.
  • The internal structure of the fit object: the fields of $pairs, $settings and the other list components. Read results through summary() and the methods, whose output is covered.
  • Message wording: the text of errors, warnings and informs.

janusplot_direction() stays experimental because a conditional test under adjust is planned. The shape helpers and janusplot_shape_sensitivity() stay experimental as study tools.

Breaking-change policy

  • Column renames in output tables are breaking and are listed in NEWS.md; 1.0.0 renamed pvalue to association_p.
  • Changes to default argument values are breaking for callers who rely on defaults and are listed in NEWS.md; 1.0.0 changed the default cell encoding and the cell orientation.
  • A deprecated symbol or argument warns for at least one minor release before it is removed.
